title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: StrongDM
providers.scope_notes: SaaS control plane (US/UK/EU); Log Stream and 13-month log viewing require the Enterprise plan, other plans see 30 days in the Admin UI.

controls.name: Role membership
controls.what: Service accounts only reach resources granted through their roles.

controls.name: Suspend user
controls.what: Suspending an account revokes its access to infrastructure.

controls.name: Permission level: Manage service accounts, admin tokens, and API keys
controls.what: Only the Administrator permission level can create or manage admin tokens, API keys, and service accounts; other levels cannot.

controls.name: Policies (Location::IP context)
controls.what: Cedar policy statements can permit or forbid a principal's resource actions based on the source IP or location.

controls_unknown: Any IP allowlist for admin tokens, API keys, service accounts, or SCIM tokens (docs silent).
Any org-wide switch to block creation of admin tokens or API keys, or a maximum expiry policy.
Whether SSO-required or MFA settings apply to service account token logins.
SCIM token rotation, revocation, and lifetime.
Service account token lifetime and rekey procedure.
Whether read-only SDK/API calls (e.g. listing accounts or resources) are recorded as Activities.
Whether API key creation logs as 'Admin token created' or a separate event.

authentication.summary: A service account is a non-human user that logs in with its token (sdm login --admin-token or the desktop app) and then gets resource access through role membership.

federation.details: No documented OIDC/workload federation for service accounts.

ip_restriction.boundary: Enterprise Policies (Cedar) can permit/forbid resource actions by context.location IP for any principal, including service accounts. No documented IP restriction on the token login itself.

lifetime.summary: Optional expiration set when creating the service account (CLI CSV name,expiration); 'Service account expired' activity is logged

renewal.summary: Activities include 'Service account rekeyed'; rekey procedure not documented on the service account page.

administration.summary: Admins create service accounts in Principals > Users > Add service; access is limited by role membership; accounts can be suspended.

sso.details: Service accounts authenticate with tokens instead of username/password, and session/idle timeouts apply only to human users.

offboard.details: Service accounts are machine principals, not tied to a human user.

inventory.details: `sdm admin services list` lists all service accounts; Principals > Users shows them with a Service Account label.

expiry.cli: sdm admin services add --csv (CSV columns name,expiration); expiry is logged as activity 'Service account expired'

usage.ui: Logs > Activities (and Logs > Queries) filtered by Account = service account
usage.cli: sdm audit activities --json (filter actorAccountID); sdm audit queries --from <date>

log_sources.name: Activities
log_sources.notes: Plus Queries and Replays for resource sessions when StrongDM log retention is enabled.

lifecycle_events.event: Attempted to login by a suspended service account from the Admin UI

anomaly_cues: Service account logins from new IPs
Resource queries outside normal job windows

containment.steps: Suspend the service account in Users, or rekey it.
containment.notes: Effect on open resource sessions not documented.

unknown: Whether suspension ends live client sessions

calls.reveals: Resources the service account can reach
calls.log_notes: Resource connections are logged as queries/replays, not Activities.

evidence.title: View Logs from the Admin UI
